professionalSummary.text: Implemented control system changes against operations specifications under the team's software standard for four years on the warehouse control system team of a retail distribution company.

experienceHighlights.text: Tested each change on the emulation rig with a documented test record attached to the change record and checked by a second engineer.
experienceHighlights.witness: Tested each change on the emulation rig with the test record attached to the change record and checked by a second engineer.

experienceHighlights.text: Took each change through the software review process with release approval recorded on the change record as the control system lead's responsibility.

experienceHighlights.text: Supported the three distribution centres' support desks with diagnostics through the support queue, recording which incidents were diagnosed by the candidate and which were passed to the automation vendor.
